Dense fitted sections — BLAZING glossy white glaze painted with pink peonies, golden birds and green leaves across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID gold-lined borders and ruby-pink enamel dots running between the sections, with mother-of-pearl flowers inlaid into the sections, high-gloss glazed, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
